decision: I chose to use OpenAI text-embedding-ada-002 when OPENAI_API_KEY is provided and fall back to a deterministic mock embedder when the key is absent.

decision: I chose to store embeddings as BSON binary vectors (packed float32) and include embeddingModel and embeddingDims metadata.

Store embeddings as BSON binary packed float32 bytes
reason: Meets prompt requirement and follows the skill guidance to store model and dims alongside vectors for future detect/re-embed tasks.

decision: I chose a vector-ivf index for the demo dataset (small, under 10k vectors).
reason: IVF is lightweight for small demos and matches the prompt requesting an 'vector-ivf index'. It has lower memory overhead and simple hyperparameters for a sample app.
